title: Detect declared-but-empty source video stream at probe
summary: Teaches Get-SourceMediaRouteProfile (source-route probe) to detect a video stream that is declared in the container header but carries zero decodable packets, and to report it via the existing probe_error='video_stream_missing' signal so the existing source-probe preflight guard marks it permanent and non-retryable.
reason: A TDARR matrix run (run-20260608-044850-full) surfaced case tdarr-0698: an external tdarr sample (sample__2160__libx265__alac__30s__video.mkv) whose mkv header declares a 2160p video stream containing no video packets. ffprobe reported the stream, so the presence-only SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING guard passed and the file routed to encode, where ffmpeg aborted with 'Cannot determine format of input after EOF'. The encode failure was classified transient and retried 3 times before giving up, wasting work on a permanently undecodable source.
behavior_before: Get-SourceMediaRouteProfile set probe_ok/probe_error purely on video-stream presence (codec_type=video). A header-only video stream (zero packets) passed the check, routed to encode, failed at ffmpeg, and was retried as a transient failure up to the retry limit.
behavior_after: When a video stream is present, the probe performs a bounded first-packet read (ffprobe -select_streams v:0 -read_intervals %+#1 -count_packets). If it positively determines zero packets, probe_ok=false and probe_error='video_stream_missing'; the existing preflight guard then records a permanent, non-retryable SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING failure and never routes the source to encode. Ambiguous or failed packet probes leave the source eligible (no false rejects).
manual_validation: pwsh parse check of media_probe.ps1 - PARSE_OK

Real-media harness via bundled ffprobe: broken asset sample__2160__libx265__alac__30s__video.mkv -> probe_ok=False, probe_error='video_stream_missing'; healthy asset (mpeg1video) -> probe_ok=True, probe_error=''
operator_validation_required: AGENTS.md section 5 media/FFmpeg rung: run the real broken source end-to-end through ops/pipeline/entrypoints/MediaPipeline.ps1 and confirm it lands as a permanent, non-retryable SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING at stage source-probe with no encode attempt and no transient retries.
Confirm a representative healthy 2160p h265 source still routes and encodes normally (regression check for the added bounded packet probe in the hot path).
rollback_plan: Revert the added bounded packet-probe block in ops/pipeline/engine/probe/media_probe.ps1 (Get-SourceMediaRouteProfile), restoring probe_ok=($null -ne $video) and probe_error=if($video){''}else{'video_stream_missing'}.
notes: Scoped deliberately to the clean media_probe.ps1 only. The source-probe preflight guard in pipeline_processing.ps1 and failure_codes.ps1 already had uncommitted in-flight changes from other work; this change reuses the existing video_stream_missing signal and SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING code to avoid touching those dirty files, adding no new failure code and no registry churn. Operator real-media rung still required before status=complete (AGENTS.md section 7 not self-certified). Summary refresh deferred to the pre-commit hook to avoid sweeping unrelated in-flight files.
